name: connections
label: Connections
documentation: Comma-separated connection slugs, e.g. instagram-mybrand, x-myhandle.

name: scheduledAt
label: Scheduled at (ISO 8601)
documentation: Future datetime, e.g. 2026-12-25T15:00:00Z or use Make's formatUNIX()/toZulu() functions.

name: timezone
label: Timezone (optional)
documentation: IANA timezone applied when scheduledAt has no offset, e.g. Asia/Kathmandu.
